summary: Some signs of overfitting: read the findings.

findings.title: Generalisation gap
findings.explanation: The model scores clearly higher on rows it trained on than on the test: some memorisation.

findings.title: Calib vs test
findings.explanation: Calib and test agree within their confidence intervals.

findings.title: Train/test overlap
findings.explanation: Some test inputs also appear, exactly or nearly, in the training rows.

examples.test: i feel like im being really needy
examples.train: i feel like im being really needy

examples.train: i don t follow too many people and i don t have too many followers however i have a feeling that the people that i am talking about may know who they are i m not trying to be rude i m just being real

examples.train: i wonder if the homeowners would feel weird if i parked to gape at their landscaping

findings.title: Selection pressure
findings.explanation: Only one experiment was compared on calib, so picking it added no optimism.

findings.title: Learning curve
findings.explanation: Dev levelled off before training ended, with no late drop.
